description.value: Grindstone Cafe is a long-established neighbourhood coffee shop on Herald Street in Victoria, open since 1990 and known for its genuinely welcoming atmosphere. Cyclists can fuel up on locally roasted coffee, made-to-order grilled sandwiches, wraps, salads, house-made Tortilla Soup, and carrot cake. A sunny street-side patio adds an appealing spot to rest on a ride through Victoria.

bike_parking_detail: 10 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 6m; stands (2 spaces) at 12m; rack (4 spaces) at 24m; rack (7 spaces) at 25m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m; stands (2 spaces) at 79m; stands (2 spaces) at 83m; stands (2 spaces) at 88m; stands (2 spaces) at 93m; stands (2 spaces) at 95m. Total: 27 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The front page of grindstonecafe.ca confirms a real, open neighborhood cafe on Herald Street in Victoria, established in 1990, with locally roasted coffee, made-to-order sandwiches/wraps/salads, and a sunny patio. The website provides a phone number (250-880-3109) absent from OSM. However, the /faq, /contact-us, /find-us, and /reviews subpages have been hijacked and redirect to Indonesian online gambling sites (FORWIN77, SLOT8808, HOKI878, TOTO399), indicating the site has been partially compromised. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the retrievable content.
concerns: Multiple subpages (/faq, /contact-us, /find-us, /reviews) have been hijacked and serve Indonesian online gambling content (FORWIN77, SLOT8808, HOKI878, TOTO399) — the website has been partially compromised and the business may be unaware.
Phone number 250-880-3109 sourced from website only; OSM has no phone on record.
OSM address is incomplete — 'Herald Street' only, no street number.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible cafe in Victoria with a confirmed web presence and active business details. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food, coffee, and a patio rest.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website owner should be notified of the subpage hijacking. The front-page content remains legitimate and the business appears fully operational.
